item.text:
Final verification is green — all four audit tests pass (`ok`, 23.7s) and the deliverable is complete.

## Audit closed — no concrete correctness defect found

**Target:** the supplied implementation is the unmodified upstream `github.com/hashicorp/raft` v1.7.3 (`c0dc6a0b2c7e889f31e5ab2f7ed90ceb159acffe`), confirmed byte-for-byte against the sumdb-backed module cache. The work copy contains only my diagnostic tests, `report.md`, and `logs/` — no implementation file was changed.

**Executed evidence:**
- Full package suite passes, apart from 17 tests that cannot create an AF_INET socket in this sandbox.
- Full suite under `-race`: zero data races; plus targeted `-race` stress of leadership transfer, pre-vote, concurrent apply, and snapshot/barrier/verify-leader.
- `gofmt` and `go vet` clean.
- Four independent audit tests, all green including under `-race`: in-memory crash/restart convergence; deposed-leader uncommitted-entry drop; randomized acknowledged-entry safety + Log Matching Property; socketless `net.Pipe` transport RPC/pipeline/heartbeat/snapshot.
- Line-by-line review of the consensus core, FSM apply loop, public API contracts, and transport layer against the Raft specification.

**Found and explained, not a defect:** `TestRaft_SnapshotRestore_PeerChange` flakes under `-race` (~2/40) from a test-timing wait; it passes 60/60 without `-race`.

**Environment-blocked coverage (not a verdict):** the literal TCP transport tests and the `fuzzy` linearizability module (AF_INET denied in the shell; `isolated_exec` not dispatchable from my side; fuzzy's `raft-boltdb`/`bolt` zips absent offline). The transport logic was still exercised via a socketless fake stream layer.

**Handoff:** [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-08_19-48-15-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md) (252 lines, with reproduction commands and a confidence/residual-risk section); 14 raw logs in [work/logs](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-08_19-48-15-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/logs); diagnostic tests `zz_audit_crash_test.go` and `zz_audit_transport_test.go`.
